subject: [AMBER] Cpptraj v13 command is not working fixatomorder

messages.author: Ana Ziad
messages.body:
Dear AMBER users,
I am using cpptraj v13
fixatomorder command does not work for me. I receive this error:
CPPTRAJ: Trajectory Analysis. V13.0
___  ___  ___  ___
| \/ | \/ | \/ |
_|_/\_|_/\_|_/\_|_
> parm 2_planes_sol.prmtop
AmberParm Title: [default_name]
Radius Set: modified Bondi radii (mbondi)
> trajin heat1.rst
[heat1.rst] contains 1 frames.
> fixatomorder outprefix reorder
[fixatomorder]: Command not found.
quit
Can you please help me sort this?
Regards

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
The 'fixatomorder' command did not exist when cpptraj for AT 13 came
out. Try using a more recent version of cpptraj, either from AT 20 or
from GitHub: https://github.com/Amber-MD/cpptraj
-Dan
